prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single isolated blank stationery sheet for the settings screen of a cozy hand-painted fantasy suitcase travel game. Genuinely transparent background. Polished 2D storybook painted cartoon matching warm caramel leather, cream paper and antique brass, rounded forms, soft dark brown outlines, gentle shading, restrained paper grain. One large nearly rectangular warm ivory sheet with subtly worn irregular edges and a very faint pale gold inset rule. Paper is angled only ONE degree clockwise. A beautiful small antique brass binder clip grips the top middle edge. At the far lower-left corner, a short warm wooden pencil lies partly outside the sheet; at the far upper-right corner, one small muted plum and ochre vintage travel ticket peeks from BEHIND the sheet. The ticket has only abstract decorative lines, no writing. ALL accessories stay in the outer 8% of the sheet; the central 82% of the paper is completely empty even cream, ready for game-rendered text and buttons. The sheet occupies about 90% of the canvas, with narrow transparent margins and a subtle close contact shadow. Everything fully inside image, no cropping. No words, letters, numbers, stamp, language labels, flags, interface controls, compass, scenery, desk or watermark. Wide landscape composition, exact 4:3 aspect ratio. The blank sheet is broad and horizontal.
